info.description:
High-performance RESTful backend API for the Timesheet Automation Portal, built with Go (Gin Engine) and PostgreSQL.
- Automated Timesheet Generator: Multi-company Excel (.xlsx) and PDF generation (MII, SDD, Adidata, NTT) with day-fraction calculations, dynamic day trimming, formula preservation, and async SMTP delivery.
- Dynamic Template Engine: Dedicated programmatic template builders alongside visual cell-mapping coordinate parsers integrated with Handsontable.
- Dual Authentication & Security: JWT sessions with NIST SP 800-63B compliant Argon2id password hashing and WebAuthn FIDO2 Passkeys (biometric & hardware-bound).
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Admin and User role segregation, centralized account administration, and profile change approval workflows.
- Web Push Notifications: Daily reminder scheduler pinned to 17:00 WIB (Asia/Jakarta) notifying active users via VAPID.
- 3NF Relational Master Data: Normalized PostgreSQL database schema (Companies, Departments, Projects, Holidays, Activity Statuses) with foreign keys and automated SQL migrations.
- API Versioning: Standardized RESTful endpoints routed under the `/api/v1/*` namespace.

builtin.description:
Builtin, when set (e.g. "bni_dev"), marks a first-class bundled template
whose fixed layout is rendered by a dedicated strict-typed generator rather
than the generic cell-mapping engine.
